description: PitchPlease v2.2 (Arduino R4, 4 x WS2811 strips over USB serial at 921600 baud). 19 values per strip, mirrored to 38 LEDs by the firmware. Sent on the v2 serial output, not DMX.
_note: Sent as perceptual values; the v2.2 firmware decodes them with gamma 2.2 (firmware since 2026-10-08; older firmware shows them without a curve). vvvv set gamma 2.2 on these but sent them with 'Apply Gamma = False'.
